name: Kumano Shouko
source:
Class: 2-D

The ace of the swimming club who however is currently taking a break from her activities. After a video of her bullying one of her classmates was filmed and went viral, Shouko was temporarily suspended from school.

She has a cool personality and doesn't talk much, which is why she is often alone. Despite appearances, she loves making sweets and is especially good at baking apple pies. Shouko is also somewhat popular with the male students as many of them keep wondering how she can swim so fast while having such large breasts.
